title: Supabase local scaffold and RLS-by-default lint
summary: Initialize supabase/ for local development and add the CI lint that fails any migration creating a table without RLS and a policy. No application tables are created in M0 (table creation is an AUTH-gated data-schema change).

acceptance_tests.test: supabase/config.toml and an empty migrations directory exist; `supabase start` works on the VM (log attached, no project keys involved).
supabase/scripts/check_rls.py scans migrations and fails when any `create table` lacks `enable row level security` and at least one `create policy` for that table in the same migration.
Two fixture migrations under supabase/scripts/tests/ (one compliant, one not) prove the pass and fail paths; pytest runs them in the lint workflow.
supabase/README.md states the RLS-by-default rule, the policy patterns (owner-only, published-read, service-role-only), and that table creation needs an AUTH.
No Supabase URL, key, or project ref appears anywhere in the PR.

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording

Staging stand-up review (M1-PLAT-01): AT-2/AT-3 met by supabase/scripts/check_rls.py + supabase/scripts/tests/test_check_rls.py (commit 2f0684e, governance `rls` job); AT-4 met — supabase/README.md now states the RLS-by-default rule, the three policy patterns and the AUTH rule; AT-5 secret-scan (no URL/key/ref in the repo). AT-1 partial: supabase/config.toml added (generated by CLI 2.118.0, GJ auth settings), but `supabase start` on the VM fails at the realtime schema-init step (container cannot reach the local DB; VM Docker networking), log summary in qa/reports/M1-PLAT-01.md §6. Status stays open for AT-1 only.
